help.title: Legend & Rule Reference (Al Brooks Price Action)
structure: HH / LH (above bars): higher high / lower high; HL / LL (below bars): higher low / lower low. Alternating HH+HL = bull structure, LH+LL = bear structure.

i / O / ii / oo / ioi: inside bar / outside bar / consecutive inside / consecutive outside / inside-outside-inside. Inside = breakout mode (stand aside); ii is one of the most reliable intraday breakout patterns.
Top regime bar: green = bull channel (bright green = spike), red = bear channel (bright red = spike), amber = trading range, purple = tight range / barbed wire.
EMA20 (cyan dashed): Brooks' trend benchmark — ≥70% of the last 20 closes on one side = trend, otherwise range.
signalList: H1~H4 / L1~L4: entry counts within a bull/bear pullback. H2/L2 = second entry, the highest-probability Brooks setup (prior ≈60%).
Wedge top/bottom: three-push reversal (span ≤40 bars); more reliable when the third push loses momentum.
Double top/bottom: two swing points at nearly the same level (tolerance 0.3×ATR, gap ≥3 bars).
TLB ↓/↑ (trend line break): a close through the trend line — a warning only: ~50% of trends resume, ~50% reverse.
MTR: major trend reversal = trend line break + test + reversal signal, all three in place.
Range break ↑/↓: trading-range breakout. Prior: 80% of breakout attempts fail and first breakouts only survive ~50% — research watch only.
Spike ↑/↓: ≥5 consecutive same-direction trend bars (spike), the origin of a spike and channel.
aiList: 🤖 AI read: one-click send of the current structure summary to the AI assistant for a Brooks-framework interpretation (requires AI configured by a superadmin).

/brooks PAIR TIMEFRAME: a slash command in AI chat (e.g. /brooks BTC 1h) that outputs the structure read directly; asking naturally "what structure is BTC in now" also triggers the structure engine tool.
scaleList: A swing needs k bars to its right to confirm (signals lag k bars by nature and never repaint). k=1 micro (noisy) → k=3 standard (recommended) → k=5 major swings. Brooks himself stresses that structure is fractal: viewing the same candles at multiple scales is itself the exercise.
help.disclaimer: This tool quantifies the bar-structure rules of Brooks' three-book series into deterministic code, for study and review only; signals are structural annotations, not trade instructions, and nothing here is investment advice.
